question: Why is the question asked by the great goddess considered rare even among the gods?
premises: The speaker acknowledges having been asked.

inference: The goddess has asked about something exceedingly rare and praiseworthy.
uncertainties: The exact content referred to by durlabham is implicit.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess; you have asked me about something hard to obtain even for the gods.
